<!-- Generated by make generate from internal/cli; do not edit. -->

`alpheus` talks to the cluster with your kubeconfig and has no server or login of its own.
Flags can come before or after the arguments, with one dash or two.
A command that fails exits with 1 and says what you can do; a wrong command line exits with 2.

Every command takes these flags:

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--kubeconfig` | The kubeconfig file (default: `KUBECONFIG` or `~/.kube/config`) |
| `--context` | The kubeconfig context (default: the current one) |
| `-n`, `--namespace` | The namespace (default: the context's) |
| `-o`, `--output` | `json` or `yaml`, for scripts (default: text) |

With `-o json` each command prints the shape its section describes, and nothing else, on stdout.
Errors, and what a replayed component prints, go to stderr.
The shapes are an interface for programs: fields may be added, but a field keeps its name and meaning.
A field that is empty may be left out.

## alpheus run

Create a StreamRun from a file.

```
alpheus run -f flow.yaml
```

Reads the file strictly, so a misspelt field is an error, and runs the controller's checks of the steps and edges first. An image without a digest gives a warning, since the controller refuses it unless it runs with `-allow-tags`.

With `-o json`: The `StreamRun` as created, with `apiVersion` and `kind`, as `kubectl get -o json` prints it.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-f string` | the flow file, or - for stdin |
| `--image value` | &lt;step&gt;=&lt;image&gt; runs a step with another image, such as a fixed version; can be repeated |
| `--log-level value` | &lt;step&gt;=&lt;level&gt; sets a step's log level: debug, info, warn or error; debug shows more of what it does; can be repeated |
| `--name string` | the run's name instead of metadata.name in the file, such as for a second run of the same flow |

## alpheus get

Show runs, or one run's status.

```
alpheus get [run]
```

Without a run, lists the runs in the namespace, or in all namespaces with `-A`. With one, shows its steps, replicas, edges with their lag, results and where to fetch them, and error logs.

With `-o json`: Without a run, a `StreamRunList` with the runs in `items`; with one, the `StreamRun`. Its `status` is described in [Using Alpheus from a program](/docs/api/).

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-A` | runs in all namespaces |

## alpheus watch

Follow a run's status live, with the lag of each edge.

```
alpheus watch <run>
```

Prints the whole status at each change, as text or, with `-o json`, one object per line. It ends when the run finishes, with exit code 0 only when it succeeded, so a script can wait for a run with it.

With `-o json`: One `StreamRun` per line, compact, each time its status changes. With `-o yaml`, one YAML document per change, each after a `---` line.

## alpheus logs

Show the logs of a run's containers.

```
alpheus logs <run> [step]
```

Shows the component's log, or the agent's with `-c agent`, of every step or one.

With `-o json`: One object per log line, compact, one per line: `pod`, `step`, `replica`, `container` and `line`. With `--kept`, `pod` is `attempt-<n>`, the attempt the log was kept from.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-c string` | the container: component or agent (default "component") |
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the S3 endpoint (default: ALPHEUS_S3_CA_FILE, or the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-ca annotation) |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint as seen from here (default: ALPHEUS_S3_ENDPOINT, the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-endpoint annotation, or spec.storage.endpoint) |
| `-f` | short for --follow |
| `--follow` | keep printing new lines until the pods end |
| `--kept` | show the logs kept from failed attempts in the bucket, also after the pods are gone |
| `--tail int` | only the last lines of each container; -1 means all (default -1) |

## alpheus cancel

Cancel a run.

```
alpheus cancel <run>
```

Sets `spec.cancel`. The controller stops the pods; chunks and results are cleaned up as for a finished run.

With `-o json`: The `StreamRun`, as for `get`.

## alpheus chunks

Show the manifest of an edge or a result.

```
alpheus chunks <run> <edge>
```

Reads the manifests of an edge, such as `filter-sum`, or of a result, `<step>.<output>`, with the keys in the run's storage Secret. When `spec.storage.endpoint` is only reachable inside the cluster, pass the address you reach it by with `--endpoint`.

With `-o json`: A list with one object per producer replica: `stream` (the edge or result), `prefix` in the bucket, `replica`, `found` (false while it has no manifest yet), `epoch`, `eos`, `last` (the number of the last chunk, set with `eos`), `observed` (counts, `errors`, `warnings` and `errorsDropped` so far), `consumed` (per input stream of the producer, the highest input chunk whose output to this stream is committed) and `chunks`, each with `n`, `ext`, `bytes`, `sha256`, `counts` and `src` (`edge`, `replica` and `n` of the input chunk it was made from).

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the S3 endpoint (default: ALPHEUS_S3_CA_FILE, or the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-ca annotation) |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint as seen from here (default: ALPHEUS_S3_ENDPOINT, the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-endpoint annotation, or spec.storage.endpoint) |

## alpheus replay

Run a failed attempt again on its own, on its inputs, at debug level.

```
alpheus replay <run> <step>
```

With `-o json`: One object when the replay has run: `failure`, the attempt's `failure.json` as described in [Using Alpheus from a program](/docs/api/#the-failed-attempt); `dir`, where the inputs were fetched; `pod`, with `--with cluster`; `command`, the podman or docker command line; `exitCode`, the component's; and `failedImage`, when `--image` ran another version than the one that failed. What the component prints goes to stderr, so stdout has only the JSON.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--agent-image string` | with --with cluster: the agent's image, which fetches the inputs; default: the controller's |
| `--attempt int` | the failed attempt; default: the last one kept |
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the S3 endpoint (default: ALPHEUS_S3_CA_FILE, or the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-ca annotation) |
| `--dir string` | where the inputs go; default: ./alpheus-replay/RUN-STEP-REPLICA-ATTEMPT |
| `-e value` | KEY=VALUE for the component, such as what the step's envFrom gives; can be repeated |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint as seen from here (default: ALPHEUS_S3_ENDPOINT, the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-endpoint annotation, or spec.storage.endpoint) |
| `--image string` | run this image instead: the same digest from a mirror, or a new version to try a fix on the same inputs |
| `--keep` | with --with cluster: keep the replay pod |
| `--replica int` | the replica; default: the one that stopped the run, else one that gave up or failed, else 0 (default -1) |
| `--skipped` | run every input chunk the replica never processed after it gave up with failurePolicy continue, instead of one attempt's |
| `--with string` | run the component with podman or docker here, as a pod in the cluster (cluster), or not at all (none: only fetch the inputs) (default "podman") |

## alpheus ui

Open a page in the browser that shows the runs live.

```
alpheus ui
```

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--agent-image string` | with --in-cluster: the agent's image, for replay pods |
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the storage endpoint |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint as seen from here, when spec.storage.endpoint is only reachable in the cluster |
| `--host value` | a host name the page may be reached by besides localhost, such as an Ingress's; can be repeated |
| `--in-cluster` | run as a Deployment in the cluster: runs of every namespace, replays as pods |
| `--listen string` | where the page is served; keep it on this machine unless --in-cluster (default "127.0.0.1:7171") |
| `--no-open` | do not open the page in the browser |
| `--replay string` | how the replay button runs: podman, docker, cluster or off; default podman, or cluster with --in-cluster |

## alpheus validate

Check a flow file without creating it.

```
alpheus validate -f flow.yaml
```

Runs the same checks as `run` and has the API server check the fields and rules with a dry run, without creating anything. `--local` needs no cluster and skips the server's checks.

With `-o json`: `file`, `valid`, `server` (true when the API server checked it too) and `warnings`, a list.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `-f string` | the flow file, or - for stdin |
| `--local` | only the checks that need no cluster; skips the CRD's schema and rules |

## alpheus results get

Fetch a run's results to a folder.

```
alpheus results get <run> [<step>.<output> …]
```

Fetches the committed chunks of every result of the run, or of the ones named, to `./<run>/` or the folder `-d` names, with a folder per result and one per replica, and `alpheus-results.json` with the run, its UID and each chunk's file, size and SHA-256. Only chunks the manifests list are fetched; other objects under the prefix were never committed. Each chunk is written as `<file>.partial` and renamed when its size and SHA-256 match, so a file without `.partial` is whole. A fetch that is stopped goes on where it stopped when run again, if the objects have not changed. It writes only into an empty folder or one with the same run's `alpheus-results.json`; `--force` uses another folder, and still only writes the run's own files. It checks the free space first, and asks before more than 10 GiB unless you pass `--yes`. When the run did not succeed, or a replica has not ended its stream, the committed chunks are fetched and the results said to be incomplete, with `complete: false` in the index and for each such replica; `--complete` makes that an error. A result larger than the disk is better read where it is: list it with `results ls`.

With `-o json`: The index it wrote to `alpheus-results.json`, as for `results ls`, with `file` set on each chunk and `errors`, the error log's files with `--errors`. With `-d -` the chunks themselves.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the S3 endpoint (default: ALPHEUS_S3_CA_FILE, or the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-ca annotation) |
| `--chunks value` | only these chunks of each replica: &lt;n&gt; or &lt;from&gt;-&lt;to&gt;, numbered from 1 |
| `--complete` | exit with an error when a result is incomplete |
| `-d string` | the folder to fetch to, made with its parents; - writes one result to stdout (default: ./&lt;run&gt;/) |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint as seen from here (default: ALPHEUS_S3_ENDPOINT, the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-endpoint annotation, or spec.storage.endpoint) |
| `--errors` | also fetch the error log, to _errors/&lt;step&gt;/&lt;replica&gt;/ |
| `--flat` | put all chunks of a result in one folder, as &lt;replica&gt;-part-&lt;n&gt;.&lt;ext&gt; |
| `--force` | fetch into a folder with other files; only the run's own files are overwritten |
| `--parallel int` | how many chunks to fetch at a time (default 4) |
| `--replica int` | only this producer replica (default -1) |
| `--yes` | fetch more than 10 GiB without asking |

## alpheus results cat

Write one result to stdout.

```
alpheus results cat <run> <step>.<output>
```

Writes the chunks of one result to stdout in order, replica 0 first, checking each against its size and SHA-256, so `alpheus results cat <run> <step>.<output> --chunks 1 | zcat | head` shows the start of a result.

With `-o json`: Does not apply: the chunks are written as they are.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the S3 endpoint (default: ALPHEUS_S3_CA_FILE, or the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-ca annotation) |
| `--chunks value` | only these chunks of each replica: &lt;n&gt; or &lt;from&gt;-&lt;to&gt;, numbered from 1 |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint as seen from here (default: ALPHEUS_S3_ENDPOINT, the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-endpoint annotation, or spec.storage.endpoint) |
| `--replica int` | only this producer replica (default -1) |

## alpheus results ls

List the committed chunks of a run's results as S3 paths.

```
alpheus results ls <run> [<step>.<output> …]
```

Lists the committed chunks as `s3://<bucket>/<key>` with their size and SHA-256, for tools that read S3 themselves, so they get exactly the committed chunks and not everything under the prefix.

With `-o json`: An index: `version`, `run`, `namespace`, `uid`, `phase`, `bucket`; `complete`, true when the run succeeded and every replica ended its stream; `replicas`, each with `result`, `replica`, `complete` (it ended its stream) and `chunks` (how many it has committed); and `chunks`, each with `result`, `replica`, `n`, `key`, `url`, `bytes` and `sha256`.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the S3 endpoint (default: ALPHEUS_S3_CA_FILE, or the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-ca annotation) |
| `--chunks value` | only these chunks of each replica: &lt;n&gt; or &lt;from&gt;-&lt;to&gt;, numbered from 1 |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint as seen from here (default: ALPHEUS_S3_ENDPOINT, the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-endpoint annotation, or spec.storage.endpoint) |
| `--replica int` | only this producer replica (default -1) |

## alpheus results gc

Delete results whose TTL has run out, or whose StreamRun is gone.

```
alpheus results gc
```

Lists the results in a bucket and deletes those whose `resultsTTL` has run out since the run finished. Results whose StreamRun is gone are kept until their TTL runs out, unless you pass `--orphans`; results with `resultsTTL` 0 are never deleted. It asks before deleting, unless you pass `--yes`.

With `-o json`: A list with one object per run in the bucket: `prefix`, `run`, `namespace`, `uid`, `finishedAt`, `reason` (why it is deleted or kept) and `action`: `delete`, `deleted` or `keep`.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--bucket string` | the bucket with the results: spec.storage.resultsBucket, or bucket |
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the endpoint |
| `--dry-run` | only show what would be deleted |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint, as in spec.storage.endpoint |
| `--orphans` | also delete results whose StreamRun is gone, before their TTL runs out |
| `--region string` | the bucket's region, as in spec.storage.region |
| `--secret string` | the Secret in -n with keys that can delete in the bucket (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY) |
| `--yes` | delete without asking |

## alpheus errors

Show the error log the components wrote.

```
alpheus errors <run> [step]
```

Shows the error log the components wrote with the chunks they committed: time, step, replica, level, code, input chunk and message, and then a count per code. With `-d` it saves the log's files under `<dir>/_errors/<step>/<replica>/` instead.

With `-o json`: One entry per line, compact, as in the error log: `time`, `level`, `code`, `message`, `fields`, `step`, `replica` and `chunk`. The count per code is only in the text.

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--ca-file string` | CA bundle for the S3 endpoint (default: ALPHEUS_S3_CA_FILE, or the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-ca annotation) |
| `-d string` | save the error log to &lt;dir&gt;/_errors/&lt;step&gt;/&lt;replica&gt;/ instead of showing it |
| `--endpoint string` | the S3 endpoint as seen from here (default: ALPHEUS_S3_ENDPOINT, the storage Secret's alpheus-dev.org/external-endpoint annotation, or spec.storage.endpoint) |
| `--tail int` | only the last entries; -1 means all (default -1) |

## alpheus version

Show the CLI, controller and CRD versions.

```
alpheus version
```

Shows the CLI's version, and the controller's and the CRD's when the cluster can be read.

With `-o json`: `cli`; `controllers`, each with `namespace`, `version` and `image`; `crd`, the versions the cluster serves; and `errors`, when the cluster could not be read.
